hero_kpi_rationale: The cloud backlog (CCB) is the primary leading indicator of future revenues in IT services, capturing structured demand for digital transformations and cloud projects.
company_description: Independent company specializing in the acquisition, exploration, development, production, and operation of oil and gas assets in the United States, primarily in the Permian/Delaware and Rocky Mountain basins.

kpis.name: Cloud Backlog (CCB)
kpis.explanation: Total amount of signed cloud contracts not yet billed, over the next 12 months.
kpis.description: CCB reflects visibility into future revenues from large cloud projects, a key growth lever for Capgemini.
kpis.signal: Strong cloud backlog growth, indicating sustained demand in digital transformation.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of services, divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved slightly due to better productivity and a more favorable service mix.
kpis.signal: Improving operational efficiency despite cost pressures.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is gradually improving, supported by internal digitalization and workforce management.
kpis.signal: Capgemini maintains cost discipline while investing in transformation.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Spending on innovation and development of technological platforms.
kpis.description: Capgemini is investing in proprietary automation tools and generative AI (such as the 'Engineering 4.0' program).
kpis.signal: Targeted investments in AI and low-code platforms.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.description: Capgemini continues hiring in cloud, cybersecurity, and AI, despite industry-wide optimization trends.
kpis.signal: Moderate headcount growth, focused on digital and AI capabilities.

kpis.name: Recurring / Subscription Revenue
kpis.explanation: Recurring revenues from digital service and subscription contracts.
kpis.description: Driven by cloud contracts and automation platforms, this revenue stream is becoming a strategic pillar.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in recurring revenue, indicating strong customer retention.

kpis.name: Underlying Earnings
kpis.explanation: FY25 Underlying earnings €8.4B, +6% YoY (+9% ex AXA IM)
kpis.description: FY25 Underlying earnings €8.4B, +6% YoY (+9% ex AXA IM)

kpis.name: Solvency II Ratio
kpis.explanation: Solvency II ratio 224% at Dec 31, 2025, +9pts YoY
kpis.description: Solvency II ratio 224% at Dec 31, 2025, +9pts YoY

kpis.name: Gross Written Premiums
kpis.explanation: FY25 Gross written premiums & other revenues €116B, +6% YoY
kpis.description: FY25 Gross written premiums & other revenues €116B, +6% YoY

kpis.name: Combined Ratio (P&C)
kpis.explanation: FY25 P&C combined ratio 90.6%, best-in-class margins
kpis.description: FY25 P&C combined ratio 90.6%, best-in-class margins

kpis.name: Underlying EPS
kpis.explanation: FY25 underlying EPS €3.86, +8% YoY despite FX headwinds
kpis.description: FY25 underlying EPS €3.86, +8% YoY despite FX headwinds

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 2.32 EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of 4.728 Bn EUR in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years using yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Percentage of net income distributed as dividends: 48.3% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Volume of AI API Calls
kpis.explanation: Number of calls to generative AI APIs used by clients in Capgemini projects.
kpis.description: Capgemini observes rapid adoption of AI in client business processes.
kpis.signal: Explosive growth in enterprise adoption of generative AI.

kpis.name: Share of deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of new cloud contracts that include AI or machine learning components.
kpis.description: Capgemini systematically integrates AI modules into its cloud offerings for large enterprises.
kpis.signal: AI is becoming standard in new cloud offerings.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate profit per share: used to calculate the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

ai_positioning.summary: Capgemini positions itself as an AI integrator, combining large language models (LLMs) with industry-specific solutions and proprietary platforms such as Engineering 4.0. The focus is on industrializing enterprise use cases.
evidence: 38% of new cloud deals include AI features
150% year-on-year growth in AI API call volume
dedicated R&D investment program in generative AI and automation
